facts.fact: CrossDesk runs Windows apps as native Linux windows: a Python host daemon drives a Windows VM under user-session libvirt and spawns FreeRDP RAIL per app; a Rust NT service in the guest talks gRPC with mTLS. Status is pre-alpha.

Single-user desktop model: the user is also the operator; no root daemon or privileged container. Operator CLI flow is doctor, install --iso-path, launch, uninstall. File sharing to the guest is opt-in, default off, with documents/home/custom scopes.

Three first-party trees: host (Python 3.9+, hatchling, grpcio, cryptography, pydantic, optional libvirt-python extra), guest (Rust workspace, tonic 0.12, windows 0.58, cross-compiled to x86_64-pc-windows-gnu), gui (Rust + cxx-qt 0.7, Qt6/QML wizard and tray).

Console scripts: crossdesk (cli.main) and crossdesk-host (daemon via __main__). CLI subcommands: install, apps, launch, config, vm credentials/autostart/shutdown, doctor, logs, metrics, version, uninstall. CROSSDESK_DEBUG=1 re-raises unexpected exceptions.

Daemon main loads config.toml, reads CA/host cert and key from configured PKI paths, selects libvirt backend (default mock; real via libvirt.backend=real or CROSSDESK_CONFIG__LIBVIRT__BACKEND), builds RailManager/RailSupervisor with real FreeRDP subprocess invocation, and starts a tonic-compatible gRPC server via RealTransport.

Host transport bind_kind: tcp forces 127.0.0.1 loopback, vsock forces AF_VSOCK, auto picks vsock on Linux and TCP elsewhere. README states every live milestone has used the loopback TCP path. Port comes from cfg.transport.vsock_port.
A separate management gRPC plane is bound on a Unix socket $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/crossdesk-host.sock used by crossdesk metrics and launch; the mgmt proto defines Launch and metrics RPCs.

Host writes under ~/.config/crossdesk: config.toml, vm.toml (0600 VM credentials), keyring.toml, settings.toml, peripherals.toml, pki dir; state_dir holds logs/crossdesk-host.jsonl and crash-reports; install also touches $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/freerdp.

Guest agent-svc main hands off to the Windows SCM dispatcher in production; agent.exe console or CROSSDESK_CONSOLE env runs the gRPC planes in the foreground without elevation; non-Windows or --features mock runs planes under tokio for the in-process harness.

crossdesk-gui is a cxx-qt QGuiApplication loading qrc Main.qml with a single-instance lock and LANG-derived translator; a crossdesk-tray crate also exists. Launch spawns the GUI when the daemon is down.

Offline commands (do not run): host: pip install -e .[dev]; ruff check src/ tests/; mypy --strict src/; pytest -q --cov=crossdesk_host. guest: cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu; cargo test --workspace --features ipc-vsock/mock; cargo clippy -D warnings. gui: cargo check --workspace plus qmllint. proto: buf lint.

AUR PKGBUILD builds the host wheel and cross-compiles agent.exe, installing a systemd user service, an ms-office protocol handler .desktop, agent.exe, publisher-root-ca.crt and autounattend.xml under /usr/share/crossdesk. flake.nix and release.yml also exist; source tarball sha256 is SKIP.

infra holds VM bootstrap and desktop integration: autounattend.xml, RDPApps.reg, mTLS cert generation script, code-signing PKI scripts, polkit policy, GNOME shell extension, Nautilus python extension, KCM module, desktop/mime files, and a crossdesk-host systemd unit.

WinApps is the named incumbent and is vendored under third_party/winapps (AGPLv3, reference only, not an execution path); docs compare it in COMPARISON_WINAPPS.md and COMPETITION.md. Parallels installer is referenced as a design reference.
